## Description

Proposed wavelet-based approach to macro-driven index allocation: Use macroeconomic and market indicators to adjust allocations among index-linked assets, with explicit publication lags and rebalance rules needed to prevent look-ahead bias. This is a concept-level interpretation of the title, not a complete trading specification: the exact model inputs/target, calibration, entry/exit or rebalance rules, and position sizing are not fully defined here.
